title: These tunnels are designed for 100,000 years
summary: Tom Scott visits Onkalo in Finland, the planned deep geologic repository for high-level nuclear waste intended to be sealed for 100,000 years.
why: Recommended in nuclear waste threads as a short, clear look at a real long-term storage solution.
